Pastoral framing instead of the slot table is what a coordinator produces when it skips the contract

Observed image motion and inferred 3D motion must be labelled separately

The deliverable is a filled camera spec; estimates must be marked ESTIMATED
With no Blender runtime the skill requires reporting BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED rather than claiming a .blend
Only files that exist may be recorded as generated
Detected cuts are candidates until both sides of the boundary are inspected
